title: Example documentation review
question: How well is this sample record documented for independent review?
rule: Sum each criterion weight multiplied by its reviewer-assigned rating. Ratings are 0 (insufficient), 0.5 (partial), or 1 (adequate for this review). A missing rating withholds the whole score. No weights are redistributed.

criteria.label: Source traceability
criteria.description: Can the reviewer locate the exact source versions used by this review?

criteria.label: Specimen identity
criteria.description: Does the supplied record distinguish the parent, prepared portions and tested specimen?

criteria.label: Method detail
criteria.description: Do the source descriptions explain the collection, preparation and analytical steps in enough detail for the intended independent review?

criteria.label: Stated limits
criteria.description: Do the sources identify missing information and limits on interpretation?
